newsitem.title: UK: Rank says no timetable for Xerox sale.
newsitem.headline: Rank says no timetable for Xerox sale.

text.p: British leisure company Rank Group Plc said on Thursday it had no specific timetable for the planned sale of its 20 percent stake in Ranx Xerox, its joint venture with Xerox Corp.

A company spokeswoman said that the company had made it clear that it did not intend to retain its 20 percent stake in the office equipment venture. The stake is valued in Rank's accounts at 930 million stg.
Rank is preparing the ground for the sale but negotiations have not yet begun. U.S. photocopier manufacturer Xerox is regarded as the most likely purchaser.
Rank said on Wednesday that it had sold its film distribution unit to Carlton Communications Plc for 65 million stg.
The company has now raised some 300 million stg by selling 11 businesses since last August.
Rank shares added 3.5p to 431p by 0900 GMT, helped by a report in the Financial Times which highlighted plans for the sale of the Ranx Xerox stake.
The stock has underperformed the market by some 20 percent over the past 12 months.
Brokers Lehman Brothers issued a note on Thursday in which they repeated their "outperform" stance.
"With Rank trading on an undemanding market rating we reiterate our Outperform rating on the shares and 12 month price target of 485 pence," it said.
